reason: The new getCredentials override (BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.java, patch lines 316-318) returns myUser.getOtp(), which now has a generated id (patch line 275). Before, the default CredentialInputUpdater.getCredentials returned Stream.empty() (CredentialInputUpdater.java:50). AccountCredentialResource.java:184/212-217 therefore no longer builds the dummy 'otp-id' credential, and the delete in BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorageTest.java:327 (Issue 19575 test) now resolves through CredentialDeleteHelper.java:64 instead of the '-id' fallback at CredentialDeleteHelper.java:75. No other test references the 'otp-id' or '-id' fallback paths.
